Night Bunker

The radio went quiet at dusk. Hold twenty rounds until dawn; every death costs the run, and the scrap you salvage buys the next one a better start.

The radio went quiet at dusk. One Night is twenty rounds in four Watches, a boss every fifth. Every bunker is different, every death costs the run, and the scrap you salvage buys the next one a better start. Board the windows, buy off the walls, read the intel slip, pick your relics, and hold until dawn. Burning, Charged and Chilled zombies react when their statuses meet, paired relics fuse, and relic tags build doctrines.

Supply depot

Scrap: 0

Scrap is salvaged from every run. Seven branches grow from the Depot; a node opens once the one above it is inked. Vault nodes also need a Service Rank. Raw power stays small on purpose; most of it buys options.

Codex

Every reaction, fusion and doctrine you find is written down here, and the first of each pays a little scrap. So is every lost radio, song and rite.
